mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, increasing infection risk in patients on candesartan who may have compromised renal function; additionally, PTU-induced hypothyroidism can potentiate hypotensive effects of candesartan.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and CBC regularly; adjust candesartan dose if hypothyroidism develops; counsel patient on signs of infection.
